thread:
maya: Quick sync Heads-up: I'm seeing inconsistent capitalization for model names across docs and snippets. PR #420 touches examples and glossary. Need a short migration plan.

liam: Short answer: treat specific model identifiers as Proper Nouns (TitleCase or hyphenated with caps when part of official name) and generic references as lowercase 'model'.

helen: Agreed. Concrete rules I'd like in the style guide: 1) Official model names: capitalize as published (e.g., "Redwood-13B", "Rdw-3b" if that's how the model is listed). 2) In prose, use lowercase 'model' unless you're naming the family. 3) In code, keep param keys idiomatic to the SDK (`model` in python/JS).

sanjay: We also have some headings using "Model" capitalized for emphasis. Should headings follow same rule?

maya: Headings should follow sentence case unless it's the model name exactly. So "Redwood-13B performance" not "Model Performance" unless it's a section about models in general.

alex: I'll add a tiny linter to docs-bot that flags `\bModel\b` in prose and suggests `model` unless it matches a whitelist of official names. Want to include a whitelist JSON in the docs repo.

tara: Can we avoid breaking existing PRs? A migration checklist would help reviewers update examples quickly.

liam: Suggested migration checklist (short):
- Run: `git grep -n "\\bModel\\b" docs | sed -n '1,400p'` to find candidates.
- Manually review each hit to determine if it's an official name or generic.
- For code blocks: ensure param keys are `model` (lowercase) and values match model catalog slugs.
- Update headings to sentence case where appropriate.

helen: I'll draft a one-paragraph glossary entry called "Model name capitalization" with examples and link to SDK snippet conventions.

maya: Add a cross-check item: ensure async examples (streaming) still show `model` kwarg correctly in both languages. We've had failures where example code didn't match the SDK API.

alex: PR #421 created: "docs-bot: add capitalization linter + whitelist". CI pending. I'll include the grep command and an example sed/awk one-liner in the PR description.

docs-bot: PR #421 updated by @alex  CI: running 527e...

sanjay: Tiny nit: keep acronyms uppercase (API, SDK, JSON). Found a few "Api" occurrences in the tutorials. Add that to the checklist.

liam: Adding: "Tech acronyms uppercase" to the checklist. Also add: lowercase `model` for param names in code.

helen: Drafted glossary text and pushed to branch `docs/glossary-model-cap`. Will link in PR #420.

maya: Plan: once #421 linter passes and #420 has glossary + snippet fixes, merge both. Assigning final sign-off to @maya (I'll do it first thing Tues). Thanks team! :raised_hands:

alex: Noted. I'll post the grep output and a short sed replace snippet in the PR: `git grep -n "\\bModel\\b" docs | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u | xargs -I{} sed -n '1,120p' {}`

maya: Perfect. Keep the fixes small so reviewers can approve quickly.

docs-bot: Reminder set: "review capitalization PRs" for @maya on 2026-03-24 09:00 PST.
